info.title: SAF Flow API
info.description: Multi-tenant API for SAF Super Admin, SAF Dine Flow, SAF Stay Flow and SAF Bill Flow. Authenticate with POST /api/auth/login (sets the HttpOnly `saf_session` cookie). Every protected endpoint enforces tenant isolation (PostgreSQL RLS), subscription state, plan entitlements and role permissions server-side.

post.summary: Confirm a Cashfree checkout: the server reads the order from Cashfree and settles it when PAID
post.description:
**Authorization:** Tenant user of the product in the URL with a usable subscription (expired/suspended allowed); role permission: subscription.view.

Mutations require header `x-saf-request: 1` (CSRF guard).
